model: Quagmire-style c=pi2(pi1(p)+pi3(k)) on GP29. Source evaluates independent pi3 versus pi3 tied to pi1, each with six declared random key-value distributions.
manuscript: LP2-00–55 canonical 12,956-rune stream. Pooled statistic uses one alphabet set; eight-section statistic uses source sections 7–9 and 11–15, omitting its nine-rune section 10, with fresh alphabets per section.
grid: Six key-value distributions x two alphabet-relationship variants x pooled/sectioned statistics = 24 settings. Both raw and anti-doublet-adjusted lower-tail P must be <=0.0001 for exclusion.
controls: G1 checks independent-alphabet mean noncentrality within 3%; G2 requires exclusion on >=18/20 flat-key ciphers for each cell; G3 voids the run if any of 20 own-family ciphers per cell is falsely excluded. The anti-doublet factor is calibrated using 200 flat-key ciphers per statistic.
draws: 100,000 seeded model alphabet draws for each LP2 and each control reference. A quick five-control/2,000-draw run is only a preflight and never scores LP2.
limitations: This is a model-family frequency screen, not a decryption or a test of all Quagmire schemes. Other key distributions, dependent alphabets, deterministic keywords, segmentation, layers and nonstationary keys are outside scope.
